sections.title: Recorded charges
sections.note: Operational snapshot. Reconcile with the accounting ledger before use. Not a tax invoice or payment request.
sections.sql: select i.code,i.due_on,l.currency,i.amount_cents,i.paid_cents,i.amount_cents-i.paid_cents balance_cents from cowork.invoices i join cowork.members m on m.id=i.member_id join cowork.locations l on l.id=m.location_id where i.member_id=$1 order by i.due_on

name: renewal-brief
title: Draft membership renewal brief
for_each: select id,name from cowork.members where status='active'

sections.title: Agreed membership
sections.note: Check signed agreement and dates before discussing renewal. Does not renew a contract or serve a notice.
sections.sql: select code,plan,space,start_on,end_on,renew_on,currency,monthly_cents,agreement_ref from cowork.membership_register where member_id=$1 and status='active' order by renew_on

name: room-run-sheet
title: Room booking run sheet
for_each: select id,name from cowork.spaces where kind='room'

sections.title: Upcoming room use
sections.sql: select code,member,starts_at,ends_at,minutes from cowork.room_diary where space_id=$1 and ends_at>=current_date and status='confirmed' order by starts_at

sections.title: Emergency plan evidence
sections.note: An evidence checklist, not an emergency plan or legal certification.

sections.title: Open actions
sections.sql: select code,name,owner,due_on from cowork.actions where location_id=$1 and status='open' order by due_on
